thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P0 -> ALB 5xx spike in AZB (euc2b) detected: error_rate 12% over 5m, affected routes: /api/v1/generate, /chat. Paging oncall-amber :rotating_light:

oncall-amber: acked. i'm looking. no alerts for infra control plane yet.

alex.sre: i'm seeing a bunch of Envoy RESET logs for connections from the ALB targets: `upstream reset` and a lot of 502/504s in the ingress pods in azb. pulling pod logs now.

maya.ops: no recent deploys from deploy-bot in the last 2 hours? @deploy-bot can you confirm?

deploy-bot: No deploys in the last 180 minutes for `api` or `ingress`. Last deploy: 3034498300 - feature/ratelimit (diff unrelated).

jasper-net: infra note: we had noisy host networking in AZB earlier, packet drops 0.2% but now normalized. could be connection reset due to keepalive mismatch between ALB and Envoy.

alex.sre: running a quick curl against health endpoint on a few targets: `curl -v http://10.10.3.45:8080/health` showing `Connection reset by peer` intermittently.

alex.sre: snippet from envoy log: ```
[2026-03-15T14:33:12Z] envoy error upstream reset, code=ECONNRESET, remote=10.10.3.45:8080
[2026-03-15T14:33:13Z] envoy response 502 for client=10.1.2.3 method=POST path=/api/v1/generate
```

maya.ops: health checks from ALB are failing intermittently: target group reports unhealthy (flapping). Could be ALB keepalive/idle timeout mismatch + heavy client concurrency -> half-closed sockets.

oncall-amber: immediate mitigation idea: 1) increase Envoy idle_timeout to 90s to tolerate ALB keepalive, 2) temporarily lower ALB keepalive to 30s to force close stale sockets, 3) shift 20% traffic out of AZB to EUC1 weighted route53 to reduce load. Any objections?

jasper-net: sounds reasonable. route53 weight change ready if you want me to apply.

alex.sre: i'll bump envoy config on the ingress ASG in AZB to increase idle_timeout, and restart one replica at a time. applying now: `kubectl -n ingress set env ds envoy IDLE_TIMEOUT=90s` (rolling).

maya.ops: applying route53 weight change to shift 20% to euc1 now. expect propagation ~30-60s.

jasper-net: reducing ALB idle timeout from 60s->30s for target group tg-azb-app. Command: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:... --attributes Key=idle_timeout.timeout_seconds,Value=30` executed.

alex.sre: rolling restart in progress. monitoring.

~2 minutes later~

alex.sre: after first ingress pod restart, 5xx rate in AZB dropped from 12%->6% but still elevated. envoy logs show fewer resets.

maya.ops: route53 weighted change propagated. euc1 is picking up ~20% traffic. overall 5xx across the cluster down to 4%.

karen-cs: any customer impact to report? which customers saw errors?

oncall-amber: we have error spike for customers on euc2b primarily; CS: short-lived failed requests for a subset of API calls, retrying clients mostly succeeded. no long-term data loss, but some users reported timeouts ~30-90s.

jasper-net: we're seeing some keepalive connections in TIME_WAIT on hosts, possibly causing ephem port exhaustion on a few nodes. i'm temporarily increasing ephemeral port range on affected hosts and clearing conntrack entries for kube-proxy. doing that now.

alex.sre: after second pod roll, AZB 5xx now ~1.5%. envoys look healthy.

incident-bot: automatic status update posted to status page: partial outage (reduced).

maya.ops: follow-up actions to prevent recurrence: 1) update ALB target group idle timeout to 45s across the fleet (not too low), 2) add runbook step to verify Envoy keepalive/timeout parity when onboarding, 3) run a short load test in AZB with max_keepalive concurrency to validate.

alex.sre: filing a post-incident ticket with root cause hypothesis: ALB->Envoy keepalive negotiation + transient host networking noise -> half-closed sockets & upstream resets -> target group flapping. will attach logs and mitigation timeline.

oncall-amber: handing off to maya for follow-up and RCA. my shift ends in 45m.

maya.ops: ack. i'll coordinate with jasper and alex on the RCA, schedule the load test, and propose config changes. will post draft RCA by EOD.

karen-cs: i'll prepare a short customer-facing note indicating brief error spike in AZB, mitigation performed (traffic shift + config changes), and expected no data loss. will ping affected accounts.

deploy-bot: No related deploys during mitigation window.

oncall-amber: thanks team. closing pager for now — monitoring for 30m, will reopen if 5xx > 3% again. :thumbsup:
